description: Turn a pasted document (a vendor's email, the text of a PDF invoice) into an invoice row. The invoice-extractor subagent reads the text against the open purchase orders and returns the fields; code validates them, resolves the requester (from the document, else the purchase order, else the caller's choice), writes the invoice as `new`, and appends a `received` event. It does not review: the UI runs review_invoice next; chat calls review_invoice with the saved id when the user also requests review. Returns { invoice_id, revision, invoice }. Available to the chat agent and to the paste panel via the direct-invoke lane.

document.description: The invoice as text: an email body, a PDF's text, a scan's OCR output, or invoice details supplied in chat.

requester.description: Who asked for the work, as Name (Team), used when neither the document nor the purchase order names one.
